why: The camera is tilted 14 deg and the block is about 7 percent nearer the camera than the ruler, so even a perfect measurement at the ruler's scale reads the block 7.8 and 9.0 percent large. ruler_mm_per_px_beside_object and object_mm_at_ruler_scale come from projecting the true corners through the render camera; they check the method itself. max_error bounds the raw error against the real 60 x 35 mm.
